newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BIL sees substantial Thistle improvement.
newsitem.headline: BIL sees substantial Thistle improvement.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd chairman Bob Matthew on Thursday said this year's operating performance of British Thistle Hotels was expected to improve substantially on last year.

"Thistle's operating profit performance this year is expected to be a substantial improvement on the previous year and there is no reason known to BIL why Thistle cannot continue its strong growth well into the future," Matthew told sharholders at BIL's annual meeting.
Earlier this year, BIL sold down its 70 percent stake in Thistle to 46 percent through Thistle's flotation on the London Stock Exchange.

Matthew said that while the last few months had been rather quiet for British listed hotel stocks, "generally we expect Thistle's current year profit improvement and strong future prospects to progressively be more fully recognised by the market."

He said this would be particularly so once Thistle had delivered on its pre-listing prospectus forecasts and the market's focus turned to Thistle's 1997 financial year potential outcome. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
